long_biography.plain_text:
Jorge L. Acevedo was born in Sagua La Grande, Cuba, and trained as a physician. At twenty-seven he moved to Miami, initially working in a centre serving older patients. The experience shaped his view that geriatric care should combine medical treatment with warmer, family-centred support.

After starting La Colonia in a small Hialeah house, Acevedo expanded the organisation across Miami-Dade and Broward counties. Its centres bring primary and specialist medicine together with diagnostics, pharmacy, transportation, rehabilitation and social services. He remains president and founder and serves as an administrator within the licensed clinic network. The system now operates twelve medical centres and supports more than a thousand employees, making community-based senior care the defining focus of his business career.

The dossier therefore classifies his relationship as Founder but does not claim current personal control of the clinic entity or quantify his equity.
